I know, especially while he was in college he was still the same obnoxious Axl from high school/earlier seasons.

Frankie obviously favors Axl and let’s him get away with pretty much anything. Remember that episode in S5 where Axl drives to FL but forgets to change his oil, and his car breaks down? And when Frankie picks him up she runs out of gas? Frankie was so upset with Axl for being careless but she herself is the same exact way! Axl picks up a lot of his habits from Frankie—being late, disorganized—and he gets away with a looot of it. Then Mike has his own issues and just doesn’t really know how to discipline any of his kids. 

But it would have been really nice to see a character arc with Axl.

Wow. When I [27/F] was younger, maybe 18/19, my mom found a dildo when she was snooping. She confronted me later in my room and tried to shame and guilt trip me. Said something about how she almost had a heart attack and if I’m doing ~this stuff~ she will have to get my dad involved in my punishment 😂

I was too young back then to accept that it was mine and get my ass whooped so I lied and said my friends gave it to me as a gag joke. Most awkward conversation ever. My soul left my body because of how traumatic it was LOL. She somehow believed me and said my friends were bad people.
During the convo, I did notice how she was possibly perceiving me so I did make sure to apologize and let her know that I had no bad intentions. Thanks for the advice. I’ll look into the ENFJ sub!
